crossRefs.note: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.
Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male…
(for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom);
“Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire…
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”
and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels…

translations.web: When Yahweh your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;
translations.bsb: When the LORD your God has delivered it into your hand, you must put every male to the sword.
translations.kjv: And when the LORD thy God hath delivered it into thine hands, thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword:
translations.asv: and when Jehovah thy God delivereth it into thy hand, thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword:
